text.p: A total of 2.72 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom 0#GAZP.RUO changed hands in electronic trading on Friday at an average 2,601.00 roubles ($0.462) a share, up from 2,428.46 roubles at the previous session on January 29, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Full details of the trading session:
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised regular auctions and electronic trading sessions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.465 at 1140 GMT on Friday on the Russian Trading System, up from $0.451 at Thursday's close.
Its American Depositary Shares were $21.10 after $21.40. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next electronic trading sessions will be held on February 7, 12 and 14.
